svg.aria-label: Animated illustration of one agent run: a task enters Commander Plus; ActionMesh checks each tool call against its contract and blocks a write to ~/.ssh/config; every call is appended to a RunLedger hash chain; BrowserProof confirms the browser landed on the claimed page; Verify checks the saved PDF. Then someone edits ledger block 3 from denied to allowed, the chain turns red from that block on, and the run is flagged for a person.

Then someone edits ledger block 3 from denied to allowed, the chain turns red from that block on, and the run is flagged for a person.

g.text: ONE AGENT RUN, END TO END
Save October’s invoice as a PDF
Running. Each call is checked against its contract and written to the ledger.
Run complete. Ledger verifies, page and file checked.
Someone edits block #3 after the run: denied → allowed.
Block #3 was edited after the run. Chain broken from #3, run flagged for a person.
An illustration of how my tools fit together in one agent run. Not a recording.
short hashes: real SHA-256 of each step
